liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Shakedown Street** (1 review): The reviewer correctly guessed Shakedown Street would open the second set [9]

## Setlist highlights

- **Liberty**: rare: 13 archived performances [16]
- **Maggie's Farm**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [16]
- **Rhythm Devils**: rare: 12 archived performances [16]
- **Johnny B. Goode**: rare: 13 archived performances [16]
- **In the Midnight Hour**: rare: 10 archived performances [16]

## The recordings

- **DeadAndCompany2016-07-13.lsd2** (recommended): source not stated; 19 songs; 190 min; rated 5/5 by 6 [1]
- **dnc2016-07-13.dnc2016-07-13mg21**: source not stated; 18 songs; 187 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [3]. Said about its sound: Volume was lowered by 1 dB after the first track, Hell in a Bucket [3]
- **dac2016-07-13.AKGmix.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 188 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [4]. Said about its sound: Track list is misaligned with the audio: the Watchtower track plays drums, and Looks Like Rain, Row Jimmy and Throwing Stones seem missing; Uploader calls the sound decent and says earlier tracking problems have been repaired [4][15]
- **dnc2016-07-13.dnc2016-07-13flac24mg21**: source not stated; 18 songs; 187 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]

## Around the show

- The crowd was friendly; the reviewer high-fived and hugged many strangers during the night [9]
- The venue is more commonly called Star Lake [4]
- The taper had many hassles getting into the venue and sat on the lawn [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **DeadAndCompany2016-07-13.lsd2**: taped by Sean Fagan; source: SPLSD2 (Cardiod+Omni) > Oade digimod UA-5 > S/PDIF > Tascam DR-100 mkII @ 24/48 [1]
- **dnc2016-07-13.dnc2016-07-13mg21**: taped by George Heston; transferred by George Heston; source: microtech gefell mg21(hyper) Nbob active cable > PFA> M148 > Tascam P2 (oade mod acm)24/48 [3]
- **dac2016-07-13.AKGmix.flac16**: taped by Toaste; transferred by Toaste; source: Front of lawn, just right of center > 2x AKG391 cardioids ORTF and 2x AKG393 hypercardioids pointed at stacks > Zoom F8 @ 44.1kHz/16-bit (4-track) > mixed to… [4]
- **dnc2016-07-13.dnc2016-07-13flac24mg21**: taped by George Heston; transferred by George Heston; source: microtech gefell mg21(hyper) Nbob active cable > PFA> M148 > Tascam P2 (oade mod acm)24/48 [2]
